content:
devon: ops-bot reported missed pages for the last 7m, getting customer thread saying alerts never arrived :worried:
ops-bot: [alert-delivery] 3 failed deliveries -> pagerduty API 401 Unauthorized for /v2/incidents (x-retry=2)
ops-bot: recent deploy changed outgoing webhook signer to use header 'X-Signature-v2' (old was X-Signature). 401 from PD started ~6367889980
sre-oncall: ack, i'm jumping on it. can someone confirm if this is paging-only or general webhook failure?
maya: just paging routes. metrics for notify-proxy show 200 for healthcheck but 4xx for /pagerduty/send
jordan: quick check of recent commit (deploy #2024.03.12-opsfix) shows this line changed:
```js
headers['X-Signature-v2'] = sign(payload, key)
// previously headers['X-Signature']
```
let me revert to test if PD accepts old header
sam.k: PD docs expect `X-Rdwd-Signature` but we were normalizing via translation layer. maybe translation broke during refactor
pagerduty-bot: API response snippet:
```json
{"error":{"message":"Invalid signature","status":401}}
```
devon: ops, start manual fallback: call PD directly with curl to ensure critical pages go out, then we'll roll back automation
ops-bot: executing manual paging script (dry-run first) -> using `/tools/manual-page.sh --inc 12345 --urgent`
ops-bot: dry-run success, actually delivered to oncall phone, sending for real now :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: good. rolling revert of translation change to use legacy header, will patch and restart notify-proxy (2 instances)
maya: restarting one instance now, second in 30s
jordan: instance-1 restarted, memory ok, logs show successful 200s to PD
sam.k: instance-2 restart done, smoke verified. delivery latency back to normal.
devon: leaving manual fallback enabled for 10m and monitoring. thanks for fast triage. can we add a short postmortem note? also need to update integration tests to catch header mismatch
sre-oncall: filing follow-up: create test for header variants, add alert that spikes 4xx on /pagerduty/send, and schedule runbook update for manual fallback steps (include curl snippet). assigning to @jordan and @maya
jordan: noted, i'll open the PR and add an automated test in notify-proxy CI
maya: adding runbook entry now, linking manual page script and PD error sample
ops-bot: NOTE: automation still disabled on the route to avoid double pages. re-enable after 6367891100 if no regressions :warning:
devon: post-incident customer comms draft incoming. closing thread once postmortem created. :slightly_smiling_face:
